title: Vendor Release Record
description: Normalized release record structure for vendor base image monitoring.

vendor.description: Vendor or OS name (e.g., ubuntu, rhel, amazonlinux)

stream.description: Release stream or channel (e.g., 24.04-lts, rhel-9, al2023)

channel.description: Channel or edition (e.g., lts, stable, minimal)

source_uri.description: Upstream source image, ISO, or AMI URI

digest.description: Checksum or image digest if available

fetched_at.description: Timestamp when this record was fetched by connector

signed.description: Whether vendor signature or checksum was validated

last_version.description: Legacy fallback field for backward compatibility
